# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven to nine years old  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v3 c22 P25](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0025)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c19 P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin-boy  <sub>[v3 c22 P23](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0023)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is a young boy with small, bare brown heels and a tiny pink tongue. He is shorter than Cedric Stanhope and grew two inches in height over the course of a year. He lost a front tooth, which was pulled out using a piece of string attached to a door.

_Sources: [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044), [v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001), [v2 c22 P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004), [v3 c22 P18](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0018)_

## Personality

Robin is a spirited, inquisitive, and occasionally mischievous boy. He exhibits a stubborn and defiant streak when disgruntled, at times threatening to be bad because he finds being good exhausting. Despite his antics, he possesses a strong attachment to Nell Harcourt and readily demonstrates genuine remorse when brought to realize his misbehavior.

_Sources: [v2 c19 P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 c19 P36](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0036), [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044), [v3 c13 P100](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0100), [v3 c13 P107](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0107), [v3 c13 P118](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0118), [v3 c22 P22](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0022)_

- Mischievous  <sub>[v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007), [v2 c22 P15](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0015), [v2 c22 P16](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0016)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Mabel Fletcher when he grows up  <sub>[v3 c22 P35](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0035), [v3 c22 P37](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0037), [v3 c22 P39](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0039)</sub>

## History

Robin came to reside at Grey Shutters alongside his twin sister Lucy, where he was cared for by Thirza Abernethy and Nell Harcourt. He frequently disrupted mealtime conversations with misbehavior, such as stretching across the table, bumping Lucy's arm, and licking his plate. Upon learning that his father had passed away, leaving a trust fund for him and Lucy, he was overjoyed to learn that Grey Shutters would remain his permanent home. After starting school, his involvement in domestic trouble decreased. On one occasion, out of jealousy over Nell's affection for Cedric Stanhope, Robin initially refused to say his bedtime prayers, though Nell persuaded him to do so. He also admitted to giving his sister the larger piece of jam-spread bread, taking pride in his improved behavior. On another occasion, after engaging in bad behavior on a Sunday, Robin suffered from a guilty conscience and confessed his remorse to Nell, who comforted him and guided him through a simple prayer. Later, he sold his pulled front tooth to Milty Gammon for two cents and announced his intention to eventually marry his classmate Mabel Fletcher.

_Sources: [v2 c19 P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 c19 P36](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0036), [v2 c19 P44](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0044), [v2 c19 P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 c22 P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 c22 P4](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0004), [v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007), [v2 c22 P20](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0020), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v3 c13 P100](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0100), [v3 c13 P107](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0107), [v3 c13 P118](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0118), [v3 c22 P18](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0018), [v3 c22 P35](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0035), [v3 c22 P39](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0039)_

## Background by volume

- Son of Richard Farrow and twin brother of Lucy Farrow  <sub>[v2 c22 P7](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0007), [v2 c22 P15](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0015), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
- Taken in to live at Grey Shutters by Thirza Abernethy and Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025)</sub>
- Inherited interest from a two-thousand-dollar trust fund following his father's death  <sub>[v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022)</sub>
